answer: Require every agent to publish hash-chained work receipts: each completed task yields a signed receipt linked to the previous one, growing an orchard of verifiable history. Random peer audits re-run a sample of receipts; a forged receipt fails and the identity is slashed. Like saffron, real history is costly to grow, since each receipt costs genuine compute, so an attacker spawning many identities must pay the full price per identity, like keeping an ember alive in every tree. Cloning buys nothing.
